[img width="605" height="86"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/ef34f90d480afdfca8ada6b7c72213a4.avif?t=1750920130[/img]

《学生时代》是一款高自由的校园养成游戏。在游戏中，你将经历纯正中国千禧代的成长之路，见证南方小城的变迁。自选性别，多重体验，任意抉择，决定你的未来，影响朋友的人生。

[img width="643" height="276"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/32c25a1ae7314aed6f2fa461d85d0473.avif?t=1750920130[/img]


[img width="605" height="86"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/8f72f10908d4c53d189ffc972b9b047e.avif?t=1750920130[/img]

自习、写作业、考试、家长会……什么？！有老师的八卦可以听？！
挑灯夜战、在赛场挥洒汗水，将奖状贴满整个墙面，你就是鹅城一中三冠王！

[img width="572" height="249"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/ee373535ceab3950e4e1e3079f9af208.avif?t=1750920130[/img]


[img width="605" height="86"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/c571990a044e7b10b186515dafa9f833.avif?t=1750920130[/img]

在学校里结识性格各异的同学：你的成长有他们的陪伴，他们的人生有你的参与。

[img width="571" height="1568"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/2bcad852c32c4e35dac09386aaa8d64e.avif?t=1750920130[/img]

[img width="605" height="86"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/e896a10107b20b983046269a6bd22c11.avif?t=1750920130[/img]

了解同学的故事，和TA从朋友变成挚友，然后两情相悦，谈一场青春无悔的恋爱！
此外，做一个小红娘也不错？助攻同学的爱情！
大量取材于真实经历的事件，力求还原原汁原味的90后学生生活。那一天，你和肖清雅看着流星划落成雨；那一天，你和孟怀安张开双臂拥抱整个世界……

[img width="572" height="258"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/a9862262edbcfdfdffee9c3a51b54da6.avif?t=1750920130[/img]


[img width="605" height="86"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/ddaa265f2ad87915fab5cd6c7ca47865.avif?t=1750920130[/img]

每一个抉择都会影响你的人生。你的未来因你的抉择而定，友人的未来更是受你的影响。毕业后的你，会成为什么样的人、和谁相伴终生？
彼此分离的婚恋结局、职业结局、朋友结局，数不胜数的结局，数量远超你的想象。

[img width="572" height="249"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/093806c985d0b264cef15d6bc6453278.avif?t=1750920130[/img]


[img width="605" height="86"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/4ae6e9d230a189e754eb9f6206581fa0.avif?t=1750920130[/img]

全球火爆的MBTI人格理论在同类游戏中的首次运用与深度挖掘。
各类人格搭配独有机制。你能完美捏出自己，有超高代入感，全程沉浸式体验。
20+精彩小游戏让你的养成决不重复枯燥。

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/74236263fdc2ee1600b5327bc0d92561.poster.avif?t=1750920130" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/74236263fdc2ee1600b5327bc0d92561.webm?t=1750920130" width="604" height="312"][/imgvid]


[img width="563" height="121"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100110/extras/cd50873a59020350ce61fa8b53aab6fe.avif?t=1750920130[/img]

[i]序章包含[b][u]小学阶段完整内容[/u][/b]，可选[b][u]男女双主角[/u][/b]游玩[/i]
data.strSnippet: 《学生时代》是一款高自由的校园养成游戏。夏日西瓜、午后吊扇和悸动的心拉你重回千禧年初。学习、锻炼、恋爱，你是要复刻曾经的成长之路，还是活出不一样的人生？12年后，你的未来如何，由你来决定！
